question: On the full frozen ironflow_bulk panel (18 monthly parquet, 2025-05..2026-10, 466 coins with candles_1h+funding+open_interest), does the funding + price-dislocation feature set improve out-of-sample forecasts of a realized-volatility STRESS event - next-24h realized variance exceeding an expanding, train-only high quantile per coin - beyond a realized-volatility-only baseline, judged on Brier / log-loss / calibration with a frozen materiality floor and Holm-adjusted uncertainty?

design.target_definition: stress event at forecast origin t for coin c: RV_{t+1..t+24} > q_{c,t}, where RV_{t+1..t+24} is the forward sum of squared hourly mark-price log returns over the next 24 complete hourly intervals and q_{c,t} is an EXPANDING, TRAIN-ONLY high quantile (0.90) of the coin's own trailing-24h realized variance observed strictly before t (no future information)
design.baseline: RV-only (persistence / HAR-style): logistic regression of the stress label on trailing realized-variance features (RV24h, RV168h, lagged RV)
design.candidate: RV + signed funding rate + absolute funding rate + mark/index premium + mark/EMA24 distance, on the same logistic form and fitting procedure as the baseline
design.feature_standardization: train-only means and standard deviations; zero-variance columns dropped

walk_forward.note: chronological expanding train-only thresholds; no overlapping forward targets across the purge boundary

inference: Holm step-down over the declared family
design.materiality_rule: the candidate's relative Brier (or log-loss) improvement over the RV-only baseline must exceed 2% relative
design.verdict_rule: symmetric: PROMOTED if materiality_met and direction improves; else NOT_SUPPORTED; INCONCLUSIVE if a holdout cannot be formed
design.holdout: chronological final holdout opened once after the prereg is frozen; never re-tuned

do_not: re-run the broad RV-forecast (FCLR-VOL-BROAD-01, closed NOT_SUPPORTED)
re-run the correction-time campaign (FCLR-VOL-CORR-01, closed NOT_SUPPORTED)
build a risk overlay (section 9 forecast gate not passed)
threshold-shop or relax the frozen floor after outcomes
wait for NEW_OBSERVED_LIQUIDATION_SOURCE (cannot fire on frozen data)
